messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@qontract.io>

Cc: Priya Rao <priya@qontract.io>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Budget range validation & procurement thresholds — Qontract

Dylan / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo today. Quick follow-up from our side on numbers so we can map internally:

- Expected monthly inference traffic: 5M — 40M tokens (spikes up to ~60M occasionally)
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + routing; average response length ~150 tokens
- Goal monthly budget band: $10k — $50k (depending on model / throughput)
- Procurement threshold: anything over $25k/month requires an approved PO and procurement review (3–4 week lead time)

Two asks: can you confirm target unit price (e.g., $/1M tokens) for the model variants we discussed, and whether Redwood supports a committed-use discount to bring predictable unit economics? If you can send a short SOW/price sheet that lists committed tiers and PO instructions, that would help us get procurement aligned.

— Samir

--
Samir Shah
Head of Product
Qontract
From: dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@qontract.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation & procurement thresholds — Qontract

Samir —

Appreciate the clear numbers. Short answers below and attaching a quick procurement checklist and a draft SOW.

- Unit economics: For the inference configuration we demoed (gpt-like open model + 4-bit quant), list price is $1,250 / 1M tokens.
- Committed tiers: we can offer stepped committed discounts — e.g., 10% at 10M tokens/mo, 18% at 25M tokens/mo, 28% at 50M tokens/mo. I put that into the attached SOW and the Procurement_Thresholds.xlsx.
- PO process: we accept standard PO with net-30. For deals > $25k/mo we require an executed SOW + PO. DocuSign flow works fine.

Notes on unit economics and sizing:
- If you target the mid-range 20M tokens/mo with the 18% discount, effective price is ~$1,025 / 1M tokens -> ~ $20.5k/mo.
- We can help tighten costs with caching and prefix reuse; that sometimes drops token spend by 15–30% depending on prompt reuse.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which monthly band you want to commit to (5–10M, 10–25M, 25–50M).
2) If > $25k/mo, loop in procurement contact and I’ll share the standard SOW/DocuSign link.
3) If you want, we can schedule a quick cost-optimization session with solutions engineering (30 mins).

I’m copying Marissa and Lauren for commercial and procurement intake.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Rao <priya@qontract.io>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@qontract.io>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation & procurement thresholds — Qontract

Thanks — a couple clarifying points from procurement:

- The procurement team expects a line-itemed SOW showing committed token tiers, per-1M pricing, and cancellation terms. Could you include an example invoice schedule (monthly billing) in the SOW?
- For legal: we need standard data residency language and a SOC2 attestation referenced in the SOW (we have your SOC2 cert on file but procurement wants it linked).
- Timeline: procurement can move in ~2 weeks if we have SOW + PO template, otherwise it’s 3–4 weeks.

Samir and I are leaning toward a 25M tokens/mo commit to balance cost predictability vs. ramp. That would put us just at the procurement threshold. Can you confirm the committed pricing at that band and any one-time onboarding/ingestion fees?

Thanks,
Priya
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@qontract.io>, Samir Shah <samir@qontract.io>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation & procurement thresholds — Qontract

Hi Priya / Samir —

Great to hear you’re leaning toward 25M tokens/mo. Confirming details below so procurement has everything on one page:

- Committed band: 25M tokens/month
- Effective unit price: $1,025 / 1M tokens (after 18% committed discount on list $1,250)
- Estimated monthly spend (billable tokens): ~ $25,625/mo
- One-time onboarding: $3,500 (optional professional services for prompt engineering + ingestion)
- Billing: monthly invoices, net-30; we’ll attach an invoice schedule to the SOW.
- Procurement docs: attached SOW includes SOC2 link and a Data Residency appendix; DocuSign flow included.

If that works, next concrete steps:
1) PR/Procurement: confirm PO approver + email to receive DocuSign.
2) Sign SOW in DocuSign (I’ll route once I have the approver email).
3) We’ll schedule the 30-min cost-opt session with Solutions Eng to review caching recommendations.

If you’d like lower unit economics we can discuss a 12-month committed contract with a deeper discount; happy to run the numbers.

Best,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
